nodes.label: Driving a motor vehicle on Idaho’s public highways requires a current driver’s license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The general current-license requirement is not paired with an invented exemption; specific residency exceptions are compared separately.

nodes.label: Idaho permits licensing beginning at age fifteen.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A person moving to Idaho must apply for an Idaho license within thirty days of establishing residence, even if the prior license remains valid.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The new-resident application deadline and the student's valid out-of-state-license exception apply under different residency conditions; retain the student's other-state residency claim.
The ordinary new-resident deadline differs from the valid other-state credential allowance for active-duty members and their named family members claiming that state's residency.

nodes.label: An Idaho college or university student may retain a valid other-state license when claiming residency in that other state.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The new-resident application deadline and the student's valid out-of-state-license exception apply under different residency conditions; retain the student's other-state residency claim.

nodes.label: Active-duty United States military members, their spouses and dependents may keep a valid other-state license while claiming residency in that state.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The ordinary new-resident deadline differs from the valid other-state credential allowance for active-duty members and their named family members claiming that state's residency.

nodes.label: An Idaho license applicant must surrender licenses and identification cards issued by another state, a United States territory or the District of Columbia.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Surrender of other United States jurisdiction credentials differs from the permission to retain a foreign license when Idaho Class D is issued.

nodes.label: A transfer applicant from another state, a United States territory or the District of Columbia must pass Idaho’s Class D knowledge test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The transfer knowledge test and the skills test for the specified long-expired state or District of Columbia license are distinct requirements; keep the expiration threshold and origin scope.

nodes.label: For a transfer from another United States state or the District of Columbia, a license expired twenty-five months or more requires a skills test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The transfer knowledge test and the skills test for the specified long-expired state or District of Columbia license are distinct requirements; keep the expiration threshold and origin scope.

nodes.label: Receiving a credential from another jurisdiction cancels the Idaho credential.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A foreign license holder receiving an Idaho Class D license is not required to hand over the foreign license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Surrender of other United States jurisdiction credentials differs from the permission to retain a foreign license when Idaho Class D is issued.
Keeping the physical foreign license does not supply authority to display or use it for driving after Idaho Class D issuance.

nodes.label: After receiving an Idaho Class D license, a driver may not display or use the foreign license as driving authority.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Keeping the physical foreign license does not supply authority to display or use it for driving after Idaho Class D issuance.

nodes.label: A driver who uses the foreign license after receiving Idaho Class D authority may face a misdemeanor citation and fine.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: Outstanding license suspensions, cancellations or revocations in another jurisdiction must be cleared before Idaho can issue a license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The source requires clearing other-jurisdiction sanctions before issuance; this section provides no waiver to contrast.

nodes.label: An Idaho Class D license authorizes operation of non-commercial motor vehicles.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This node defines Class D scope; the accepted section supplies no contrasting full license-class definition requiring a comparison.

nodes.label: Idaho drivers seeking an international driving permit must contact AAA because ITD does not issue that permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: ITD provides reasonable disability accommodations and equal access to its facilities, programs and services.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A skills examiner must administer an equal test regardless of an applicant’s disability.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: An applicant seeking disability accommodations should give the county DMV two weeks to arrange them.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: An Idaho driver must carry the driver’s license while operating a vehicle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The license-carrying duty has no separately accepted substitute-document exception in this section.

nodes.label: Misusing or mutilating a license, instruction permit or identification card is a misdemeanor.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A worn, broken or damaged license must be replaced with a duplicate.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: Knowingly giving false information on a license, identification-card or permit application exposes the applicant to perjury prosecution and causes the credential to be canceled.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The false-information rule retains knowledge, prosecution exposure and cancellation; no unsupported lesser-offense alternative is supplied.

nodes.label: County sheriff driver’s license offices issue Idaho licenses, identification cards and instruction permits.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: An Idaho credential photograph must show the face fully from the front.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: Applicants generally remove face or head coverings for the credential photograph, with possible medical or religious exceptions.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: The REAL ID Act sets minimum security standards for state-issued driver licenses and identification cards.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The REAL ID standard is taught before its Star Card implementation; the relation is definitional rather than an invented conflicting rule.

nodes.label: Federal agencies cannot accept a state driver license or identification card for official purposes when the issuing state does not meet the REAL ID security standards.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The federal acceptance restriction and the option to obtain an Idaho Star Card describe different decisions; do not recast optional issuance as universal federal acceptance.

nodes.label: The Star Card is an Idaho driver license or identification card marked with a star to show compliance with federal REAL ID security standards.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The Star Card's star/compliance definition has no second card-marker definition in the accepted section.

nodes.label: Obtaining an Idaho Star Card is optional.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The federal acceptance restriction and the option to obtain an Idaho Star Card describe different decisions; do not recast optional issuance as universal federal acceptance.

nodes.label: Applicants younger than seventeen must finish approved driver training and the graduated licensing program before licensing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The accepted under-seventeen training/GDL duty is preserved directly; related R04 narrows the audience rather than contradicting it.

nodes.label: A driver training permit lets a person aged fourteen and a half through under seventeen attend an approved public or private driver training program.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The stated younger training-permit age band and the seventeen-or-older Class D instruction-permit path are distinct permit descriptions; do not resolve the separate older-training-permit source debt by inference.

nodes.label: During enrollment in driver training, the training permit allows driving only with the training instructor.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: Instructor-only driving during course enrollment is retained as a standalone stage restriction; no unsupported instructor-eligibility rule is added as a contrast.

nodes.label: Successful driver training completion and return of the permit by the instructor make the applicant eligible to begin supervised instruction.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A parent or guardian with verifiable custody or guardianship must act as liability signer for an applicant younger than eighteen.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The liability-signer rule for applicants below eighteen differs from the explicitly described eighteen-year-old instruction-permit case.

nodes.label: A person aged eighteen may apply for a Class D instruction permit without a liability signer.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The liability-signer rule for applicants below eighteen differs from the explicitly described eighteen-year-old instruction-permit case.

nodes.label: An applicant aged seventeen or older can use a Class D instruction permit for one year of accompanied driving practice.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The stated younger training-permit age band and the seventeen-or-older Class D instruction-permit path are distinct permit descriptions; do not resolve the separate older-training-permit source debt by inference.

nodes.label: The adult accompanying a Class D instruction permit holder must be at least eighteen and hold a valid driver’s license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The Class D instruction-permit companion minimum is eighteen; the GDL instruction supervisor minimum is twenty-one. Keep each permit stage explicit.
The ordinary instruction-permit adult age does not replace the twenty-one-year-old adjacent-driver condition printed for the under-sixteen daylight exception.

nodes.label: Issuance of a Class D instruction permit requires passing the knowledge test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Knowledge testing before the described instruction permit differs from the knowledge-and-skills requirements after GDL before licensing; no retest count is inferred.

nodes.label: A driver younger than sixteen is limited to daylight driving unless a licensed driver aged at least twenty-one occupies the adjacent front seat.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The ordinary instruction-permit adult age does not replace the twenty-one-year-old adjacent-driver condition printed for the under-sixteen daylight exception.

nodes.label: For the under-sixteen driving restriction, Idaho defines daylight as five in the morning through ten at night in local time.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This is the source's local-time definition for the immediately related daylight restriction, not a competing definition to be fabricated.

nodes.label: The documents required for a driver training permit are the same documents required for a driver license application.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This accepted document-equivalence statement does not enumerate the document list; no contrasting list is invented in this section.

nodes.label: For the first six months after license issuance, a driver younger than seventeen may carry no more than one passenger younger than seventeen unless the passengers are related to the driver through blood, adoption or marriage.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A person aged seventeen or older may take driver training using a Class D instruction permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: A person aged seventeen or older may use a driver training permit or, after driver education, a supervised instruction permit for driver training.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: For the driver training permit described for applicants aged fourteen and a half to younger than seventeen, the handbook gives an expiration five days after the holder turns eighteen.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.label: An applicant younger than seventeen who has never held an Idaho license must complete approved driver training and the GDL requirements.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The never-licensed-Idaho qualifier is retained; the related general under-seventeen rule is complementary, not a sourced contradictory alternative.

nodes.label: The graduated licensing path requires at least six months of supervised instruction without violations.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The minimum supervised calendar period and the logged driving-hour requirement measure different things and are not substitutes.

nodes.label: The supervising driver during the GDL instruction period must have a valid license and be at least twenty-one.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The Class D instruction-permit companion minimum is eighteen; the GDL instruction supervisor minimum is twenty-one. Keep each permit stage explicit.

nodes.label: During GDL supervision, the supervising driver must sit in the front seat next to the learner.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The required supervisor's adjacent front seat differs from the prohibition on another front-seat passenger during GDL supervision.

nodes.label: The GDL learner may not carry another passenger in the front seat during supervised instruction.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The required supervisor's adjacent front seat differs from the prohibition on another front-seat passenger during GDL supervision.

nodes.label: A GDL learner must ensure that every occupant uses a seat belt or required child restraint.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The GDL occupant-restraint duty has no accepted alternative restraint cutoff within this section; preserve the required-child-restraint wording.

nodes.label: The supervised GDL period requires compliance with the laws on alcohol and other intoxicating substances.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The compliance-with-intoxicants statement supplies no BAC or penalty value in this section, so no numerical contrast is invented.

nodes.label: The GDL learner must log at least fifty hours of supervised driving.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: The minimum supervised calendar period and the logged driving-hour requirement measure different things and are not substitutes.

nodes.label: At least ten of the supervised GDL driving hours must occur at night.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: The night-hour requirement is linked as part of the total supervised hours; a separate unsourced night-driving quota is not introduced.

nodes.label: A conviction for a traffic violation committed while driving under the supervised instruction period cancels the permit and requires a new permit application.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Permit cancellation and reapplication are distinct from the restarted minimum period after a new permit is issued; both retain the driving-violation-conviction trigger.

nodes.label: After a conviction for a traffic violation committed while driving under supervised instruction, a newly issued permit starts the minimum six-month supervised period again.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Permit cancellation and reapplication are distinct from the restarted minimum period after a new permit is issued; both retain the driving-violation-conviction trigger.

nodes.label: Completion of the GDL requirements must be followed by passing the knowledge and skills tests before a license is issued.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Knowledge testing before the described instruction permit differs from the knowledge-and-skills requirements after GDL before licensing; no retest count is inferred.

nodes.label: Approved Idaho driver training includes thirty hours of classroom teaching.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Classroom training hours and instructor-accompanied driving hours are separate components; retain each stated count and activity.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to each accepted fact; no official frequency or difficulty claim.

confusable_with.why: Both training components use six hours, but one is in-vehicle observation and the other is driving with an approved instructor; preserve the activity and instructor qualification.
